inlines.v: CRAFTY, adjective 1. Cunning; artful; skillful in devising and pursuing a scheme, by deceiving others, or by taking advantage of their ignorance; wily; sly; fraudulent. He disappointeth the devices of the crafty Job 5:12. 2. Artful; cunning; in a good sense, or in a laudable pursuit. Being crafty I caught you with guile. 2 Corinthians 12:16.
